en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a large statue of a robed man standing on an ornate pedestal with sculpted figures, placed on wide stone steps in a town square. Surrounding the monument are multi-story buildings with shuttered windows and, in the background, a crenellated tower. The image has a printed caption at the top identifying the monument and its location.
